stories.title: Nations League: Yamal führt Spanien zum Sieg, auch England triumphiert

en.title: Nations League: Yamal leads Spain to victory, England also triumphs
en.summary: World champion Spain defeated Croatia 4:1 in a Nations League match. England's team under Thomas Tuchel won 2:0 against Czech Republic.

stories.title: Nations League: Liga A – Yamal glänzt gegen Kroatien – England siegt in Prag

en.title: Nations League: League A – Yamal shines against Croatia – England wins in Prague
en.summary: The young player scored twice in Spain's 3:1 victory over Croatia in a Nations League match. England defeated Czech Republic 2:0.

stories.title: Une expulsion provoquée et un but d’entrée, la Suisse douche l’Ecosse à Glasgow

en.title: A provoked expulsion and an early goal, Switzerland douses Scotland at Glasgow
en.summary: Switzerland defeated Scotland 3:0 in a Nations League Group B match in Glasgow after Scotland was reduced to ten players early in the game. Goals came from Rodriguez, Elvedi, and Amdouni.

stories.title: Erneuter Sieg in der Nations League: Die Schweiz gewinnt gegen Schottland mit 3:0

en.title: Another Nations League victory: Switzerland beats Scotland 3:0
en.summary: Switzerland's national team played a controlled match in Glasgow and benefited from an early red card against Scotland. The team continues on Saturday in Lucerne under coach Murat Yakin.

stories.title: Dezimierte Schotten chancenlos – Dank Rodriguez & Elvedi: Schweiz legt in der Nations League nach

en.title: Depleted Scotland helpless – Thanks to Rodriguez & Elvedi: Switzerland advances in Nations League
en.summary: Switzerland defeated Scotland 3-0 in a Nations League match, dominating the team that played much of the game with reduced numbers. Goals came from Rodriguez, Elvedi, and Amdouni.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - La Suisse enchaîne en dominant l'Ecosse 3-0 à Glasgow

en.title: Nations League - Switzerland extends streak by dominating Scotland 3-0 in Glasgow
en.summary: Switzerland secured a second Nations League victory by beating Scotland 3-0 away in Glasgow. Goals were scored by Ricardo Rodriguez, Nico Elvedi, and Zeki Amdouni.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Kiew arbeitet an besserer Abwehr russischer Jetdrohnen

en.title: War in Ukraine – Kyiv works on better defense against Russian jet-powered drones
en.summary: Kyiv is intensively developing defensive measures against jet-powered drones that have disrupted the city for weeks. Efforts to counter this threat are accelerating.

stories.title: Massive Sanktionen drohen – Premier League bestätigt: ManCity ist schuldig in über 100 Fällen

en.title: Massive sanctions loom – Premier League confirms: Manchester City guilty in over 100 cases
en.summary: Manchester City has been found guilty in almost all of its charged violations in a Premier League disciplinary case. Significant sanctions are expected to follow.

stories.title: Notre graphique: voici la hausse des primes maladie, assureur par assureur

en.title: Our chart: here is the increase in health insurance premiums, insurer by insurer
en.summary: Swiss health insurance premiums are rising 5% on average in 2027, but increases vary significantly between insurers. Price differences between insurance companies across French-speaking Switzerland have a larger impact on costs than the highest increases from individual insurers.

stories.title: Primes d’assurance maladie en hausse: Berne renvoie la balle aux acteurs de la santé

en.title: Health insurance premiums rising: Bern passes the buck to healthcare actors
en.summary: Facing a 5% increase in health insurance premiums, the Swiss federal government says it has launched necessary reforms and calls on healthcare providers to take responsibility. Federal health counselor Elisabeth Baume-Schneider stated tools exist to reduce healthcare costs.

stories.title: Les assurés sont "pris à la gorge": les réactions fusent après l'annonce de la hausse des primes maladie

en.title: Insured are "squeezed": reactions pour in after health insurance premium increase announcement
en.summary: The latest health insurance premium increase draws universal opposition, though solutions are debated. Doctors, hospitals, insurers, political parties, and unions all called for measures, divided between reducing unnecessary services and revising financing systems.

stories.title: Une hausse moyenne de 5% pour les primes maladie en Suisse l'an prochain

en.title: Average 5% increase in health insurance premiums in Switzerland next year
en.summary: Health insurance premiums in Switzerland will rise by an average of 5% in 2027, reaching 412 francs per month. Authorities attribute the increase to expanded medical treatments, medical advances, and population aging.

stories.title: Vom Impfstoff-Superstar zum Ärgernis: Die schwierige Suche nach der Zukunft von Biontech

en.title: From vaccine superstar to nuisance: Biontech's difficult search for its future
en.summary: Biontech is closing three German facilities for which it found no buyers and is refocusing entirely on cancer medications. The company faces significant challenges as it pursues this new strategic direction.

stories.title: Der wohl ungewöhnlichste Börsenprospekt der Welt: Anthropic warnt vor dem Ende der Menschheit durch KI

en.title: Probably the world's most unusual stock prospectus: Anthropic warns of humanity's end through AI
en.summary: US tech companies are increasingly highlighting AI risks in public statements, though President Trump dismisses such warnings as fraudulent. Industry observers suggest financial self-interest may motivate these public cautions.

stories.title: Peter Spuhler macht mit der Nachwuchsförderung bei Stadler Rail Ernst. Der neue CEO ist erst 42

en.title: Peter Spuhler takes youth development at Stadler Rail seriously. The new CEO is just 42
en.summary: Stadler Rail's incoming CEO Philipp Brunner, age 42, is regarded as results-oriented in his implementation approach. He will need to adapt to Peter Spuhler's continued prominent role as board president and major shareholder.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Wirtschaftsaussichten für die Schweiz verbessern sich +++ Der Schweizer Zugbauer Stadler Rail erhält einen neuen CEO

en.title: BUSINESS BRIEFS - Economic outlook for Switzerland improving +++ Swiss train manufacturer Stadler Rail appoints new CEO
en.summary: Switzerland's economic outlook is improving. Stadler Rail, a Swiss rail manufacturer, has appointed a new chief executive officer.

stories.title: Lindt & Sprüngli verkauft deutlich weniger Schokolade als erwartet – die Aktie bricht ein

en.title: Lindt & Sprüngli sells significantly less chocolate than expected – stock plummets
en.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli reduced its revenue forecast for the second time this year, citing a hot summer's negative impact on sales, though underlying challenges run deeper.
